metadata.authentication: per-endpoint HMAC-SHA256 with independent demo pre-shared keys
metadata.network_mode: loopback TCP; two separate listening endpoints in one process
metadata.warning: Loopback-only research transport. HMAC authenticates message possession of a shared key but does not encrypt traffic; the shared key is unsuitable for untrusted public clients. Deployments need authenticated confidential transport, independent operators, identical database snapshots, and a separate anonymity layer. Two colluding replicas recover the index.
